_comment: DEV-ONLY predicted gaps for PREREG_V2 §3, computed by python -m simulator.e3v2_dev_analysis from Phase A cells (real Mistral-7B generations, real grading) and Phase B on dev. Nothing is selected or frozen here: the primary (profile, price), D*[SPEC] and m3 are fixed at freeze.

definitions.delta_speculative: mean_i [U_i(Ours-v2[SPEC]) - U_i(D*[SPEC])], D*[SPEC] = dev-best of B9+, SPEC, SPEC-theta
definitions.interaction: mean_i [Delta_i[COMMIT] - Delta_i[SPEC]] on the same items
definitions.U_i: Q - lambda_l (TTFA - skip TTFA)/1000 - lambda_c n_retrievals, mean over 5 seeds
definitions.se: paired cluster bootstrap over items (pair_id clusters for d2_support), B=2000
definitions.price_grid: lambda_l = (b_q (g+ + g-) - g- - lambda_c) / ((E[L] + pi)/1000), b_q = dev end-of-turn belief quantile

revision.status: the single pre-freeze dev rerun (PI decision); nothing frozen
changes: r_below added to the pre-registered B9+ timing family and to the shared SPEC/SPEC-theta trigger family (21-point dev grid each)

Ours-v2 lookahead corrected once: value of waiting = p * next-partial value + (1-p) * end-of-turn value, p from the remaining-speech quantiles, measured partial availability spacing; same in Ours-v2[SPECULATIVE]
Phase A top-up for 5 re-traced dev items (d1_open-popqa-2474729; d2_support-03210, -03215, -06201, -10123)
revision.previous: docs/research_v2/v2_predictions_pre_lookahead_fix.json (B9+ family without r_below, lookahead before the correction)
revision.caveat: As implemented, p(another partial) = P(R + end_gap > spacing) with aged R quantiles clipped at 0; on every dev condition end_gap >= spacing, so p is ~1.00 at every partial step (including the last). The mixture therefore never takes its end-of-turn branch on dev and this rerun does not exercise the intended correction. See paper/lab_log.md 2026-10-16.
